title: How security leaders see AI being used in the SOC
summary: Only 18% of teams have structured, enforced frameworks for how AI should be used in the SOC. Security leaders aren't struggling to adopt AI. They're struggling to control it, explain it, and defend it. Learn what you can do to improve AI governance.

title: Elastic Stack 9.4.10 released
summary:
Version 9.4.10 of the Elastic Stack was released today. We recommend you upgrade to this latest version. We recommend 9.4.10 over the previous version 9.4.9

For details of the issues that have been fixed and a full list of changes for each product in this version, please refer to the release notes.
